algorithm: Linked-list insertion sort: extend sorted prefix for ordered item, otherwise detach current original node and splice at its position in sorted prefix.
complexity: O(n^2) worst time, O(1) auxiliary space; sorted/reversed families linear. Actual mandatory insertion-sort algorithm, not array sort/mergesort.
effects: Relinks original next fields only; every original physical node appears once, values unchanged, output acyclic. One private dummy never returned. Equal-value stability chosen but not required by reference contract.
native_wrapper: Original official native interface, not solve equivalence or immutable observer qualification
